sources.snippet: EngiOpt cgan_cnn_2d This repository stores EngiOpt checkpoint packages for one model family. Each checkpoint package contains model weight files together with run_config.json and metadata.json so evaluation can run without depending on W&B run config state.

sources.snippet: In EngiOpt, we have a collection of models that can be used to generate designs. Each model is defined under a dedicated folder in the engiopt package. For example, the cgan_cnn_2d folder contains the code for the Conditional GAN model. In each model folder, there are two scripts; one for training the model, and one for evaluating the model.
